The architecture ontology is currently the **generated production ontology** (`ontologies/software-architecture.ttl`), not the temporary hand-written stub.  
Per the project memory (“Trivyn-generated production architecture ontology delivered; stub ontology retired (M2)”), the earlier stub (`architecture.ttl`) was intentionally temporary and has been replaced by the Trivyn-generated CCO/BFO-grounded ontology from `spec/architecture-ontology-brief.md` (namespace `https://trivyn.io/ontologies/software/architecture/domain/`).
